items.title: Hypolite Charles Interview, 1963-04-13
items.q: I know Lawrence Vega, he used to take music lessons the same time with me at Manuel. ... But I didn't know him well

ctx.x: Well we didn't ask him about that, about when the white players began to play. What time did those white players begin to show up in the bands in New Orleans?

Playing jazz? Oh I'm sure it must have been around 1915 and 16. Because Vega and them, they the first ones started. Lawrence Vega, you heard of them? Yeah. Well Lawrence Vega and them, they the first ones start playing that jazz. They were. And not Johnny Deechard because Johnny Deechard was in the theater. Oh my. Let me see what's the other name. Schilling, Vega, and they had another one there.
There was Fisher and Brown. Fisher and Brown.
